text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
SOLD FOR DEMOLITION - Iapetos - (built 1973) 119,500 dwt sold to Indian breakers for $195 per ldt.
Feax - (built 1976) 116,281 dwt sold to Indian breakers for $197.50 per ldt.
Vakis T - (built 1971) 49,998 dwt sold to Indian breakers for $201.50 per ldt.
Venturer - (built 1972) 29,081 dwt sold to Indian breakers for $221 per ldt.
Some of these sales may not be final as they maybe subject to inspection, survey or other conditions before completion.
